description: Land Title Settlement Department - Kandawala, Rathmalana D/S Division, Colombo District - Cad. Map No. 5210001
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination for specific land parcels (Nos. 36, 37, 61, 104, 128) with detailed land ownership information, including parcel numbers, extent measurements, owner names and addresses, title classifications, and encumbrances. The content falls squarely within the Land Gazette category as it involves land registrations, property ownership determinations, and land title settlements.
